review_scope: EU free movement and third-country family-member visa, entry, residence, procedure, remedies, and operational practice
source_evidence_policy: Topic evidence may cite a human-reviewed official reference within its reviewed scope, even when no local copy exists or a stored copy remains unaccepted. Capture, extraction, replay and semantic gates apply only to retained local artifacts or extracted passages relied on beyond direct review.
completion_rule: Country review is complete only when every required topic has all required layers covered by an accepted local artifact or a separately recorded usable official reference, or a reasoned not-applicable entry; every applicable Directive article is mapped or reasoned not applicable; every resolved dependency has evidence; local-copy acceptance checks pass for artifacts relied on beyond direct review; a validated case-law batch records all 55 planned searches across the eleven RIS court collections with every result screened; and all nine Land plus every BMEIA representation task has a final evidence-backed disposition.

machine_checked_completion_requirements.covered_layer: At least one accepted local artifact or separately recorded usable official reference is required; unknown IDs and unreviewed references keep the layer open.
machine_checked_completion_requirements.resolved_dependency: A non-empty evidence list is required; unresolved, unknown, or article-map-review statuses keep the gate open.
machine_checked_completion_requirements.case_law_discovery: The 55 planned query tasks must be represented exactly once in a complete batch; every task needs a checked date, numeric result count, and a screening disposition for each result. Included decisions need a holding, outcome, procedural posture, and applicability limits.
machine_checked_completion_requirements.operational_discovery: Every terminal Land or mission field needs a verified value or reasoned not-applicable result, an official publisher URL or accepted source ID, and checked_on date. No-source results need exact queries, searched scope, date, numeric result count, and all result dispositions.
